title: Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional) visa - subclass 188

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This visa allows you to own and manage a business in Australia, conduct business and investment activity in Australia or undertake an entrepreneurial activity in Australia

sections.heading: Overview > Eligibility
sections.text:
- Submit expression of interest (EOI) in SkillSelect
- Nominated by a state or territory government agency or Austrade
- Invited to apply for the visa
